articles.title: India’s forex demand shifts beyond metros as tier-2, tier-3 cities take 53% share
articles.summary: Emerging from the shadows of larger cities, smaller Indian towns now contribute to over 50% of foreign exchange demand. The appetite for leisure travel fuels this growth, with travelers aged 25 to 40 at the forefront.

articles.title: Smartphone to be locked for missed EMI? RBI’s new rules for lenders, defaulting borrowers explained
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has laid out some guidelines for lenders on recovery of loans, and whether they can block or lock the device that has been purchased via EMI financing. This new framework will come into effect from January 1, 2027.

articles.title: Who decides tariff for nuclear power generated by private players? Draft Shanti Rules throw some light
articles.summary: Chairperson of the Central Electricity Authority is to be present in all review matters related to nuclear power tariff for the private operators.

articles.title: Anthropic's IPO may hinge on a $200 billion revenue bet: Here's what investors are looking at
articles.summary: Anthropic forecasts remarkable revenue growth by the year 2028, with projections estimating earnings reaching between $190 billion and $200 billion. Investors closely analyze other tech companies like Palantir and SpaceX in light of these figures.

articles.title: Nvidia’s SpaceX bet: Chipmaker discloses $21 billion stake in Elon Musk-owned rocket firm
articles.summary: Nvidia owns about 123 million shares of SpaceX, estimated at around $17 billion. Additionally, the chip giant invested in Elon Musk's xAI prior to its merger with SpaceX. As part of their collaboration, SpaceX will employ Nvidia's technology exclusively for its data centers.

articles.title: Why India's GCC boom is facing a talent problem — and what companies want next
articles.summary: Talent shortages are a growing strategic risk for India's global capability centres. These skill gaps are delaying product launches and limiting digital transformation programs. Rising costs and employee pressure are also contributing to the talent challenge.

articles.title: FCNR(B) inflows could reach $85 bn including ECBs, OFCBs, says SBI Research
articles.summary: Foreign currency inflows under the RBI’s special mobilisation scheme could reach $85 billion, including FCNR(B) deposits, OFCBs and ECBs, despite the scheme being shortened by a month, SBI Research said.

articles.title: Petrol export levy cut to nil, diesel and ATF duties retained: What changes from August 15
articles.summary: In a recent announcement, the government declared a temporary removal of export levies on petrol for a duration of two weeks. However, diesel exports will incur a duty of Rs 24 per litre, while aviation turbine fuel exports will be subject to a Rs 19.5 per litre levy.

articles.title: Indian Army signs ₹1,577 crore drone contracts With Tata, Nibe for 840 long-range attack drones
articles.summary: The Indian Army is stepping up its drone warfare capabilities with a ₹1,577 crore order for 840 long-range one-way attack drones from Tata Advanced Systems and Nibe Defence.

articles.title: India’s big semiconductor push: PM Modi says 7-8 plants coming up in few years; stresses self-reliance in chips
articles.summary: Looking ahead, PM Modi said an additional five to eight semiconductor plants are expected to be established over the next seven to eight years, further advancing India's journey towards Aatmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat.

articles.title: ‘No-go’ to ‘go-ahead’: PM Modi hails ‘Samudra Manthan' for deep-sea exploration in Independence Day speech
articles.summary: To speed up offshore exploration, the government approved Samudra Manthan – the National Offshore Exploration Scheme on July 31, 2026. The scheme has been allocated Rs 84,084 crore for Phase I, covering the period up to FY2030-31.

articles.title: 'At least one Indian bank should...': PM Modi's ambitious target for India Inc ft. Fortune 500
articles.summary: In his address to the nation from the ramparts of the Red Fort, PM Modi said that India should aim to have 50 companies among the Fortune 500 in the coming decade.

articles.title: PM Modi’s Independence Day speech: Energy security demand of our times; no shortage of gas, fuel, urea
articles.summary: Speaking about the country's long-term energy strategy, the Prime Minister stressed that energy security is a key national priority. He said India is working towards achieving 100 gigawatts of nuclear power capacity.

articles.title: ‘Fragile 5 to fastest growing’: PM Modi talks of India’s economic growth during Independence Day speech
articles.summary: Talking about the dream to become a developed country by 2047, PM Modi said, “The world will be forced to look at India differently when the most populous country becomes a developed nation.”

articles.title: Ghaziabad to Noida Airport by Namo Bharat: Proposed stations, projected journey time and approval status
articles.summary: NCRTC's proposed 72.44-km Ghaziabad–Jewar corridor combines Namo Bharat and Metro services across 22 physical stations. See the proposed stops, alignment and current approval status.

articles.summary: Compare seven short getaways from Delhi for the August weekend, with realistic distances, traffic-dependent drive times and one crucial warning: Sultanpur National Park is seasonally closed.

articles.title: No artificial lights, only billion of stars: How Nashik’s tribal village is turning darkness into tourism gold
articles.summary: India’s major cities often have skies dominated by artificial glow, with only the brightest celestial objects visible to the naked eye. The problem is global.

articles.summary: From Murthal’s famous parathas to Ladakh’s mountain pit stop, discover 6 North Indian dhabas that transformed from roadside eateries into legendary food destinations loved by travellers.

articles.summary: Siberian Husky to Pug, several popular dog breeds face serious heat challenges in India’s harsh summers. Know why these breeds struggle and what owners should watch for.

articles.title: Trump admin accuses over 40 nations including India of helping China evade tariffs - what it means
articles.summary: The White House report classifies more than 40 countries into three separate tiers based on their alleged role in transshipment activities.

articles.title: US stock market today: Wall Street drifts near record highs; economic data in focus
articles.summary: The bond market was largely steady after government data showed that consumer spending at US retailers declined from the previous month. The reading caught economists off guard, as they had expected retail sales to post another monthly increase.

articles.title: RBI limits FCNR(B) forex swap facility after $52.3 bn inflows; ECB, OFCB window stays open
articles.summary: The central bank said on Friday that the facility will now be available for FCNR(B) deposits mobilised only until August 31, 2026. However, swaps against these deposits can continue to be availed from the RBI until September 11, 2026.

articles.title: How did the first clockmaker know the right time? The answer lies in the Sun, water and stars
articles.summary: For most of human history, there was no clock to consult. So when the first mechanical clocks appeared, how did their makers know what time they were supposed to show?

articles.title: India's big chip ambition: Can it become the world's next semiconductor hub?
articles.summary: Semiconductors sit underneath almost everything today: electronics, EVs, telecom, AI, data centres, defence, manufacturing. So having a self-reliant semiconductor ecosystem is an absolute necessity in the current globally uncertain economic and geopolitical environment.

articles.summary: Expenditure department says criteria may have restricted competition, homegrown firms welcome move, will help them participate

articles.title: India's forex reserves climb to $707 billion, rise $14.1 billion in a week
articles.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves jumped a notable $14.136 billion, reaching a total of $707.002 billion for the week ending August 7. This surge was largely driven by a $9.946 billion rise in foreign currency assets, complemented by a $3.995 billion increase in gold reserves.

articles.title: Delhi Metro to run from 4 am on Independence Day—here is what ordinary passengers and invitees must know
articles.summary: Delhi Metro will start at 4 am on August 15, with 30-minute service on all lines until regular operations begin. Here is who gets special QR tickets and which stations serve Red Fort.

articles.title: Reliance-Rolls-Royce AMCA Engine deal: What the proposed aerospace gas turbine complex will do
articles.summary: As part of the proposed partnership, the two companies will explore setting up a dedicated Aerospace Gas Turbine Complex in India.

articles.title: Bank of Baroda raises $700 million through overseas bond issuance
articles.summary: The bonds were issued through the bank’s International Financial Services Centre Banking Unit at GIFT City and received strong demand from international investors. The order book peaked at $2.67 billion, representing demand of nearly 3.8 times the final issue size.

articles.title: 30 lakh artisans, one big moment: PM Vishwakarma beneficiaries enter the spotlight
articles.summary: PM Vishwakarma beneficiaries get a historic Red Fort invitation as 100 artisans showcase India’s traditional crafts, women makers and the impact of a scheme supporting 30 lakh workers.

articles.title: Before August 16: The LPG update every household needs to know
articles.summary: LPG consumers need to complete e-KYC before August 16 to avoid subsidy issues. The process uses Aadhaar linking, mobile verification and face authentication for digital confirmation.

articles.title: 800 kmph in 5.3 seconds: China train sets third record in six months
articles.summary: China's experimental maglev train achieved 800 kmph in just 5.3 seconds. This remarkable acceleration sets a new world record for short-distance travel. The technology is not intended for passenger transport due to extreme acceleration levels.

articles.title: Warner Bros-Discovery deal: David Ellison may move Paramount out of California, sets October 1 deadline
